verdict.rationale: Eqvista's round-modeling tool shows cap-table dilution from new investments, accounts for a new option pool, and takes pre/post-money valuation and investment amount as inputs. The analysis can be downloaded as a PDF to share with stakeholders, and a community user praised the round modeling feature. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that SAFEs convert within the round model (only adding SAFEs to the cap table and spreadsheet note conversion are documented), detailed pro-forma ownership output, and in-app scenario sharing beyond a PDF export.
